Forre told the King to his face that the Darran Kingdom is losing the war, and Alexander denied the line had slipped.
The King accepted the party's answer and warned them not to fail him.
Prince Forre admits he keeps the Queen's rumour alive on purpose, calling it a fire that warms his house.
The King charged the party not to fail him as they left the war room.
Prince Forre openly admits he lets the Queen's rumour burn because it serves his own house.
The King states plainly that no one has seen where the missing dead go.
Fort Vicinitas is a sprawl of grey stone and iron on the ridge, its walls scored with the scars of old wars, banners snapping in the wind, gates open, air thick with horse sweat and woodsmoke.
Captain Kaelen commands Fort Vicinitas; he wears scarred, dented plate armour with a longsword at his hip, and his face is grim and his eyes hard.
